# Configuration reference

Every setting is an environment variable with the `EXCAT_` prefix (also read from `.env`). Secrets should come from AWS Secrets Manager / your vault, never from source control.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXCAT_ENV` | `Literal` | `prod` | Runtime environment. `prod` enforces strict security checks at startup. |
| `EXCAT_PUBLIC_URL` | `str` | `http://localhost:8000` | External base URL users reach the app on. Used for Origin/CSRF checks and links. |
| `EXCAT_LOG_LEVEL` | `str` | `INFO` | Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. |
| `EXCAT_LOG_JSON` | `bool` | `True` | Emit structured JSON logs (recommended outside local dev). |
| `EXCAT_API_DOCS_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | Serve Swagger UI at /api/docs and ReDoc at /api/redoc. |
| `EXCAT_METRICS_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | Expose Prometheus metrics at /metrics (block this path at the load balancer). |
| `EXCAT_CORS_ORIGINS` | `str` | `` | Comma-separated extra origins allowed for CORS and state-changing requests. |
| `EXCAT_FQDN` | `str | None` | — | Public hostname (e.g. `exposurecatalyst.company.com`). When set, the public URL becomes `https://<fqdn>[:https_port]` and drives SAML/OIDC URLs, email links, allowed hosts and CSRF origins. Unset = previous behaviour (EXCAT_PUBLIC_URL). The Docker deployment defaults it to `localhost`. |
| `EXCAT_HTTPS_PORT` | `int | None` | — | External HTTPS port (default 443). |
| `EXCAT_HTTP_PORT` | `int | None` | — | External HTTP port that redirects to HTTPS (Docker; default 80). |
| `EXCAT_TLS_MODE` | `Literal` | `self-signed` | Docker proxy certificate source (see Settings → Certificates & Domain). |
| `EXCAT_HSTS` | `bool | None` | — | Send Strict-Transport-Security. Unset = previous behaviour (sent when EXCAT_COOKIE_SECURE is true). |
| `EXCAT_HSTS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | `int` | `63072000` | HSTS max-age (default two years). |
| `EXCAT_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `str` | `` | Load balancers in front of the Docker proxy whose X-Forwarded-* headers are trusted (CIDRs; read by run.sh/compose). |
| `EXCAT_OUTBOUND_PROXY` | `str` | `` | Corporate HTTP(S) proxy for outbound calls (exported as HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY by run.sh). |
| `EXCAT_TIMEZONE` | `str` | `UTC` | Container timezone for logs (TZ). The app stores and computes in UTC. |
| `EXCAT_DEPLOYMENT` | `Literal` | `standalone` | Set to `docker` by docker-compose; enables Docker-only defaults (fqdn=localhost). |
| `EXCAT_CERTS_DIR` | `Path` | /var/lib/excat/certs | Docker certs volume (proxy certificate, trusted CA bundle). Absent outside Docker. |
| `EXCAT_SETUP_TOKEN_HOURS` | `int` | `24` | Validity of the first-run setup token. |
| `EXCAT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN` | `bool` | `True` | Docker: on an empty installation create the default break-glass Super Admin with the generated password from the secrets volume (password change + MFA enrolment forced at first sign-in). false = setup-token wizard instead. |
| `EXCAT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME` | `str` | `breakglass` | Username of the default break-glass account. |
| `EXCAT_SECRETS_DIR` | `Path` | /var/lib/excat/secrets | Docker secrets volume (generated by init). |
| `EXCAT_CONFIG_FILE` | `str | None` | — | Path to the YAML config file. Read only when set (docker compose / run.sh point it at config/exposurecatalyst.yaml). |
| `EXCAT_FEATURES` | `Features` | `PydanticUndefined` | Feature flags (`features.<name>` in YAML, `EXCAT_FEATURES__<NAME>` in the environment). |
| `EXCAT_DATABASE_URL` | `SecretStr` | `sqlite:///./exposurecatalyst.db` | SQLAlchemy URL, e.g. `postgresql+psycopg://user:pass@host:5432/excat?sslmode=require`. SQLite is for development only. |
| `EXCAT_DATABASE_PASSWORD` | `pydantic.types.SecretStr | None` | — | Database password injected separately (e.g. ECS secret from the RDS-managed secret's `password` field). When set, it is inserted into EXCAT_DATABASE_URL, which then needs no password. |
| `EXCAT_DB_POOL_SIZE` | `int` | `10` | Connection pool size (non-SQLite). |
| `EXCAT_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW` | `int` | `20` | Extra connections allowed above the pool size. |
| `EXCAT_DB_POOL_RECYCLE_SECONDS` | `int` | `1800` | Recycle connections after N seconds. |
| `EXCAT_DB_ECHO` | `bool` | `False` | Log every SQL statement (debug only — never in prod). |
| `EXCAT_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | `pydantic.types.SecretStr | None` | — | Fernet key used to encrypt secrets at rest (TOTP seeds, connector credentials). Generate with `exposurecatalyst gen-key`. Required in prod. |
| `EXCAT_ENCRYPTION_KEYS_PREVIOUS` | `pydantic.types.SecretStr | None` | — | Comma-separated previous Fernet keys, accepted for decryption during key rotation (see `exposurecatalyst rotate-secrets`). Remove once rotation has completed. |
| `EXCAT_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` | `int` | `30` | Sign out after N minutes of inactivity. |
| `EXCAT_SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` | `int` | `480` | Maximum session lifetime regardless of activity. |
| `EXCAT_COOKIE_SECURE` | `bool` | `True` | Mark session cookies Secure (HTTPS only). Must be true in prod. |
| `EXCAT_LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `int` | `5` | Failed logins before the account is locked. |
| `EXCAT_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES` | `int` | `15` | Account lockout duration. |
| `EXCAT_LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | `int` | `10` | Login attempts allowed per client IP per minute. |
| `EXCAT_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` | `int` | `12` | Minimum password length for local accounts. |
| `EXCAT_REQUIRE_MFA_FOR_LOCAL_ADMINS` | `bool` | `True` | Local accounts holding admin permissions must enrol TOTP before using admin APIs. |
| `EXCAT_NVD_BASE_URL` | `str` | `https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0` | NVD CVE API 2.0 endpoint. |
| `EXCAT_NVD_API_KEY` | `pydantic.types.SecretStr | None` | — | NVD API key (raises the rate limit from 5 to 50 requests / 30 s). |
| `EXCAT_KEV_URL` | `str` | `https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/feeds/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json` | CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities JSON feed. |
| `EXCAT_EPSS_API_URL` | `str` | `https://api.first.org/data/v1/epss` | FIRST EPSS API endpoint. |
| `EXCAT_EPSS_BULK_URL` | `str` | `https://epss.empiricalsecurity.com/epss_scores-current.csv.gz` | Daily EPSS bulk CSV (used when many CVEs need scores). |
| `EXCAT_EPSS_BULK_THRESHOLD` | `int` | `2000` | Switch from per-CVE API lookups to the bulk CSV above this many CVEs. |
| `EXCAT_FETCH_INTERVAL_MINUTES` | `int` | `60` | Default refresh interval for every source (override per source in Settings). |
| `EXCAT_INITIAL_BACKFILL_DAYS` | `int` | `7` | Days of NVD history fetched on first run. |
| `EXCAT_CVSS_PREFERRED_VERSIONS` | `str` | `3.1,4.0,3.0,2.0` | Order of CVSS versions used for the headline score and severity. |
| `EXCAT_SCHEDULER_EMBEDDED` | `bool` | `False` | Run the ingestion scheduler inside the API process (single-node / dev only). |
| `EXCAT_SCHEDULER_TICK_SECONDS` | `int` | `60` | How often the scheduler checks for due sources. |
| `EXCAT_JOB_STALE_AFTER_MINUTES` | `int` | `120` | A source stuck in `running` longer than this is considered crashed and re-claimable. |
| `EXCAT_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `30.0` | Timeout for outbound HTTP requests. |
| `EXCAT_HTTP_MAX_RETRIES` | `int` | `5` | Retries for 429/5xx/transport errors. |
| `EXCAT_HTTP_BACKOFF_BASE_SECONDS` | `float` | `2.0` | Exponential backoff base delay. |
| `EXCAT_HTTP_BACKOFF_MAX_SECONDS` | `float` | `120.0` | Maximum backoff delay. |
| `EXCAT_HTTP_USER_AGENT` | `str` | `ExposureCatalyst/0.1` | User-Agent sent to upstream sources. |
| `EXCAT_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST` | `str` | `services.nvd.nist.gov,www.cisa.gov,api.first.org,epss.empiricalsecurity.com` | Comma-separated hostnames the app may call. `*.example.com` matches subdomains. |
| `EXCAT_SSRF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS` | `bool` | `False` | Allow outbound calls to private/loopback/link-local/metadata addresses. Keep false unless an on-prem integration requires it. |
| `EXCAT_SSRF_RESOLVE_DNS` | `bool` | `True` | Resolve hostnames and block private results (DNS rebinding guard). |
| `EXCAT_ADVISORY_SOURCES` | `str` | `` | Extra tools always added to a new advisory's asset validation matrix (comma-separated, in order), e.g. tools you report on manually. Enabled asset-source integrations are always added; analysts choose per advisory which tools appear in the email. |
| `EXCAT_ADVISORY_SLA_DAYS` | `dict` | `{'CRITICAL': 7, 'HIGH': 14, 'MEDIUM': 30, 'LOW': 90}` | Default remediation due date per severity, in days from advisory creation (a still-future CISA KEV due date wins when earlier). |
| `EXCAT_ADVISORY_REMEDIATION_TIMEFRAMES` | `dict` | `{}` | Remediation timeframes by asset classification, per severity — shown in exposure-analysis emails and used for each asset's due date in the Excel file. Example (YAML): `HIGH: {"HTA Infrastructure Components": 60, "Cloud Infrastructure": 60}`. Empty = only the single SLA due date is shown. |
| `EXCAT_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES` | `int` | `5242880` | Maximum size of a CSV/XLSX asset upload (bytes). |
| `EXCAT_UPLOAD_MAX_ROWS` | `int` | `10000` | Maximum rows imported from one asset upload. |
| `EXCAT_SMTP_ALLOWED_PORTS` | `str` | `25,465,587,2525` | Ports an admin may configure for the SMTP relay. |
| `EXCAT_SMTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS` | `bool` | `False` | Allow an SMTP relay on a private/internal address (common for corporate relays). Cloud metadata addresses are always blocked. |
| `EXCAT_SMTP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT` | `bool` | `False` | Allow SMTP without TLS. Development only (e.g. a local Mailpit); never in prod. |
| `EXCAT_SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `30.0` | SMTP connect/send timeout. |
| `EXCAT_CONNECTOR_MAX_ASSETS` | `int` | `10000` | Maximum affected assets fetched from one integration for one CVE (result is flagged truncated). |
| `EXCAT_CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `60.0` | HTTP timeout for connector API calls. |
| `EXCAT_CONNECTOR_CACHE_MINUTES` | `int` | `60` | Re-use an integration's CVE results younger than this instead of calling the tool again. |
| `EXCAT_NEWS_INTERVAL_MINUTES` | `int` | `30` | Default refresh interval for news feeds. |
| `EXCAT_NEWS_RETENTION_DAYS` | `int` | `90` | Delete news items older than this. |
| `EXCAT_NEWS_MAX_ITEMS_PER_FEED` | `int` | `100` | Newest items processed per feed per run. |
| `EXCAT_AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `90.0` | Timeout for AI provider calls. |
| `EXCAT_AI_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS` | `int` | `24000` | Maximum untrusted context characters sent per AI request. |
| `EXCAT_AI_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS` | `bool` | `False` | Allow self-hosted AI endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio) on private/loopback addresses. |
| `EXCAT_AI_RATE_LIMIT_PER_USER_PER_MINUTE` | `int` | `20` | AI requests allowed per user per minute. |
| `EXCAT_RETENTION_SESSIONS_DAYS` | `int` | `30` | Delete expired or revoked sessions older than this. |
| `EXCAT_RETENTION_JOB_RUNS_DAYS` | `int` | `90` | Delete ingestion job-run history older than this. |
| `EXCAT_RETENTION_AI_USAGE_DAYS` | `int` | `400` | Delete AI usage records older than this (13 months default). |
| `EXCAT_RETENTION_ALERT_EVENTS_DAYS` | `int` | `365` | Delete delivered alert events older than this. |
| `EXCAT_FRONTEND_DIST_DIR` | `Path` | `frontend/dist` | Built React app served at /. |
| `EXCAT_DOCS_SITE_DIR` | `Path` | `dist/docs/site` | Built MkDocs site served at /docs. |
| `EXCAT_DOCS_EXPORTS_DIR` | `Path` | `dist/docs/exports` | DOCX / standalone HTML guides offered in Help Center → Download documentation. |
| `EXCAT_HELP_DIR` | `Path` | `docs/help` | In-app help Markdown (single source with docs). |
| `EXCAT_BRAND_DIR` | `Path` | `brand` | Brand kit (logos, tokens) used in emails, exports and docs. |
| `EXCAT_CHANGELOG_PATH` | `Path` | `CHANGELOG.md` | Changelog shown in Help Center → What's new. |
